answer.reason: The adapter's switch maps each vendor value to exactly one core member (SF_OK→usable, SF_LOW_RES→rescan-needed, SF_MARGIN_UNCLEAR→unreadable), and no domain spec or glossary names the three verdicts. The only place the core branches on it (case-order.ts) checks just usable versus everything else, so the three-way split comes from the vendor, not from a domain need.
